# ZCode 4.0.0 UI source overlay

These files are copied without behavioral changes from the public ZCode repository:

- Repository: https://github.com/zai-org/ZCode
- Commit: `a4b4445141eb7d3b3e99eada9292775383bfc44e`
- Upstream version: `4.0.0`
- License: Apache-2.0

The course build aliases these modules over the older vendored Lingdong UI files so the
model and reasoning controls use ZCode's original `ModelConfigSelect` composition menu.
Course access control, model allowlists and Vibe usage limits remain in the course shell.
